profile.title: Start your park history
profile.description: Save a private visit even if you only remember the month or year.

overview.title: All your visits in one place
overview.description: Find every park you saved and open a visit to add attractions, memories and your private ratings.
overview.privacy: This passport is private and only visible to you.

exports.title: Export your passport
exports.description: Download all your visits, ride entries and private ratings. The versioned JSON is ready for a future re-import; the CSV ZIP contains six tables linked by export-only references, without internal identifiers.
exports.retention: The file stays private, requires your signed-in session and expires one hour after it is generated.
